setup_deadline_probe.probe_source:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=root/'deadline-fixture'; repo.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def run(cmd,**kwargs): return subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20,**kwargs)
for command in (['git','init','-q'],['git','config','user.name','Probe'],['git','config','user.email','probe@example.invalid']):
 p=run(command,cwd=repo); assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
(repo/'app.py').write_text('def value():\n    return 1\n')
(repo/'test_app.py').write_text('import unittest\nfrom app import value\nclass Contract(unittest.TestCase):\n    def test_value(self): self.assertEqual(value(), 1)\n')
for command in (['git','add','.'],['git','commit','-qm','fixture']):
 p=run(command,cwd=repo); assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
engine=root/'deadline-engine'; engine.write_text(f'''#!{sys.executable}\nimport pathlib,sys,time\nif sys.argv[1:] == ['--version']:\n    time.sleep(2); print('cosmic-ray, version 8.9.0')\nelse:\n    p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]); p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('return 1','return 2'))\n'''); engine.chmod(0o755)
plan={'version':1,'tests':['test_app.Contract.test_value'],'mutants':[{'id':'fault','module':'app.py','operator':'core/Fixture','occurrence':0}]}; planpath=root/'deadline-plan.json'; planpath.write_text(json.dumps(plan))
results={}
for label,script in [('before',root/'deadline-runner/mutate.py'),('after',Path('skills/constrain/scripts/mutate.py').resolve())]:
 receipt=root/(f'deadline-{label}-receipt.json'); start=time.monotonic()
 p=run([sys.executable,str(script),'--repo',str(repo),'--plan',str(planpath),'--engine',str(engine),'--output',str(receipt),'--test-timeout','10','--total-timeout','1'])
 results[label]={'exit':p.returncode,'elapsed_ms':round((time.monotonic()-start)*1000,3),'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr,'receipt_exists':receipt.exists(),'receipt':json.loads(receipt.read_text()) if receipt.exists() else None}
assert results['before']['exit']==0 and results['before']['elapsed_ms']>=2000
assert results['after']['exit']!=0 and 'deadline' in results['after']['stderr'] and not results['after']['receipt_exists']
(root/'deadline-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
print({key:{k:v for k,v in row.items() if k in ('exit','elapsed_ms','receipt_exists')} for key,row in results.items()})
